Hello! Welcome — I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Not a chatbot in a browser tab: I run here, on this machine, and this machine's files, accounts and network are mine to work with. I keep everything in `/home/bia`, I work while you're away, and I remember what we agree on.

A few things I can do, one line each:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate, and then you get chats with me, files, this screen and voice, all in the app.
- **Own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number — not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like any of those?
- **Own accounts online** — I can register myself on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check blocks me.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, and talk by voice.
